newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-NOTIONNEL TO TARGET 129.61 IF 128.96 HOLDS.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-NOTIONNEL TO TARGET 129.61 IF 128.96 HOLDS.

text.p: As long as September notionnel futures on MATIF hold above Wednesday's low of 128.96, they have the scope to push up towards 129.48 then 129.61, technical analysts said on Thursday.
"What I see here is that we will hold above 128.96 and from there test 129.61, the trendline resistance, ahead of the 129.98 level" said Guenter Redeker, technical analyst at Chase in London.
He noted the market had to break through its high so far this session of 129.38, then Wednesday's high of 129.48 before making an assault on 129.61.
By 0800 GMT September notionnel futures on MATIF were down 0.04 at 129.44.
To the downside, Redeker said a break below the session low so far of 129.20 would leave key support at 129.14.
"That's pretty important. If the market holds that level, we could build a bullish pattern on intraday charts of an inverted head and shoulders," he said.
Charts show the market hit a low of 129.14 on August 5.
Bob Emanuels, vice-president of ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett in Amsterdam, said he expected an attack on support levels just below 129.00.
"The market is not oversold so there is still room for a further decline here," he said. "We believe we'll get an attack on the former lows...just below 129.00, around 128.90,95."
By 0803 GMT, September Pibor futures were up two basis points at 96.45.
